title: The Last Bus
summary: A school-bus driver has six children, a quarter tank and a horn that calls the dead.

beats.text: Six kids were asleep on my bus when I heard the first groan outside.
The school behind us had gone silent. I was the last driver left.
"Boats leave Pier Four at dawn," the radio said. Fifty miles away.
beats.speaker: announcer

beats.text: My bus is loud. The engine calls them, and so does the horn.
Ollie, ten, counted heads out loud. "Six. Seven with you."
beats.speaker: ollie

beats.text: I made one rule. Never stop, never honk.
The needle showed a quarter tank. The only pump for miles was crowded.
Then the road ahead lit up. A wall of cars, and nowhere to turn.
Sol woke up and started to cry. It was loud.
